div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p1.text: Real Simple Labs, Inc. ("Real Simple Labs," "we," "our," or "us") operates Parker AI (also marketed as HeyParker.ai) ("Parker" or the "Service"), an AI agent platform that provides intelligent automation and assistance services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul8/li0/p0.text: User inputs and prompts submitted to AI agents

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul8/li1/p0.text: Feedback on AI responses and corrections

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul13/li0/p.text: Process and respond to your AI agent requests

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul15/li0/p.text: Train and improve our AI models (with appropriate anonymization)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul20/li0/p.text: Application hosting and serverless compute on Vercel

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul20/li1/p.text: Database, authentication, and file storage managed through Supabase, with encryption at rest (Supabase's underlying infrastructure runs on Amazon Web Services)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul22/li1/p.text: Account data: Duration of account plus 30 days

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul22/li2/p.text: Analytics data: 24 months in aggregated form

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul22/li3/p.text: Billing records: As required by law

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul24/li0/p.text: TLS encryption for data in transit between your browser, our application, and our infrastructure providers

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul24/li1/p.text: Encryption at rest for stored data, provided by our database and storage vendor (Supabase)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul24/li2/p.text: Authentication via short-lived access tokens with rotation, including for the Save to Parker browser extension

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul24/li3/p.text: Application-level access controls scoped by organization, brand, and role

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul24/li4/p.text: Backup and disaster-recovery operated by our infrastructure providers (Supabase, Vercel)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul24/li5/p.text: No method of transmission or electronic storage is completely secure; we cannot guarantee absolute security

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p26.text: We integrate with the following services that may process your data:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul35/li0/p.text: Personal data is anonymized before use in model training

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul35/li1/p.text: You can opt out of having your data used for training

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul35/li2/p.text: We implement differential privacy techniques where applicable

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul37/li0/p.text: AI responses are generated based on your inputs and our models

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul37/li1/p.text: We do not guarantee accuracy of AI-generated content

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul37/li2/p.text: Conversations may be reviewed for quality assurance

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul39/li0/p.text: We only collect data necessary for AI functionality

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul39/li1/p.text: Automatic deletion of unnecessary conversation data

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul39/li2/p.text: Regular audits of data collection practices

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul42/li0/p.text: Request copies of your personal data

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul42/li1/p.text: Export conversation history and agent configurations

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul42/li2/p.text: API access to retrieve your data programmatically

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul44/li0/p.text: Update or correct your account information

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul44/li1/p.text: Delete specific conversations or entire account

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul44/li2/p.text: Right to be forgotten (where legally applicable)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul46/li0/p.text: Opt out of data use for model training

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul46/li2/p.text: Control over data sharing with third parties

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p48/strong.text: We do not sell your personal data.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p49.text: We may share information in these circumstances:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul53/li1/p.text: Hosting and infrastructure providers (Vercel for application hosting; Supabase for database, authentication, and file storage)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul53/li2/p.text: Identity providers (Supabase Auth, which validates both email/password and Google OAuth sign-in; Google, for the Google OAuth method)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul55/li1/p.text: To protect our rights and users' safety

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul55/li2/p.text: In response to valid legal requests

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul57/li0/p.text: Data may be processed in regions operated by our hosting and infrastructure providers (Vercel and Supabase)

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul57/li1/p.text: We implement appropriate safeguards for international transfers

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul57/li2/p.text: Compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable regulations

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul64/li0/p.text: Manage cookie preferences in your account settings

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p66.text: In the event of a data breach:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul67/li0/p.text: We will notify affected users within 72 hours

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul67/li1/p.text: Relevant authorities will be informed as required

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul67/li2/p.text: We will provide clear information about the incident and our response

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p69.text: Our platform is not intended for users under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul71/li0/p.text: We may update this policy periodically

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul71/li1/p.text: Users will be notified of material changes

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul71/li2/p.text: Continued use constitutes acceptance of updates

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p76.text: This policy is governed by the laws of the State of California and complies with:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p79.text: This section describes how the "Save to Parker" Chrome browser extension (the "Extension") collects, uses, and protects your information. The Extension is a separate distribution of Parker that you install from the Chrome Web Store. By using the Extension, you agree to the data handling practices described in this Privacy Policy, including this section. To the extent of any conflict between this section and the rest of this Policy in matters specific to the Extension, this section controls.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/h380/stron.text: 16.1 Supported Platforms and Where the Extension Runs

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p81.text: The Extension provides its "Save to Parker" feature on the following surfaces — the only places it injects a Save button, scrapes content, fetches additional metadata, or sends anything to Parker:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p84/strong.text: Transient in-memory observation on the broader install domains.
On LinkedIn the Extension retains no network responses at all

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p85/strong.text: What the Extension does on non-supported pages within those domains.
never sends anything to Parker servers.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p86.text: The Extension does not run on, read from, or modify any website outside the six install domains listed above.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/h387/stron.text: 16.2 Data the Extension Reads from Supported Platforms

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p88.text: When you visit a supported surface listed in §16.1, the Extension reads:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul89/li0/p.text: Page metadata visible in your browser:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul89/li2/p.text: No Facebook session tokens or cookies are ever transmitted to Parker servers.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul89/li3/p.text: For Facebook posts and photos specifically:
No Facebook session tokens or cookies are ever transmitted to Parker servers.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul89/li4/p.text: For Facebook Reels and video posts specifically:
No Facebook session tokens or cookies are ever transmitted to Parker servers.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul89/li6/p.text: No Pinterest session tokens or cookies are ever transmitted to Parker servers.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul89/li8/p.text: does not intercept or retain any network response
never issues a request of its own to LinkedIn
no action on your behalf on LinkedIn

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/h390/stron.text: 16.3 Data the Extension Sends to Parker

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p91.text: When you click "Save to Parker" and confirm a save, the Extension sends the following to your Parker account:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul92/li0/p.text: The URL of the saved post or ad.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul92/li1/p.text: Caption or description text, author display name, author handle, author profile picture, publicly displayed engagement counts, and the platform-specific identifier of the saved item.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul92/li2/p.text: A copy of the media (image or video) you are saving.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul92/li3/p.text: The organization, brand, and board you selected in the save dialog, plus any optional notes you typed.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p93.text: The Extension does not send to Parker any other browsing history, page content from non-supported sites, or platform credentials.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul96/li1/p.text: We do not transfer Extension data to third parties for purposes unrelated to providing the save-to-Parker feature, except as described in §8 (Data Sharing and Disclosure) or as required by law.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul96/li2/p.text: We do not use Extension data for serving advertisements, including personalized, retargeted, or interest-based advertising.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul96/li3/p.text: We do not allow humans to read Extension data, except (i) with your explicit consent — including consent you provide when you contact us with a specific support request that requires us to access the specific Extension data needed to resolve that request; (ii) for security investigations or to comply with applicable law; or (iii) when the data is aggregated and anonymized and used for internal operations consistent with this Policy.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul99/li0/p.text: Your Parker access token, refresh token, and token expiry timestamp (used to authenticate with Parker's backend).

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul99/li1/p.text: A locally cached copy of your Parker user profile (account ID, email, display name) and your accessible organizations and brands, used to populate the popup and the save dialog without re-fetching from Parker on every interaction. This cache is refreshed when you click "Refresh connection" in the popup.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul99/li2/p.text: Your most recently selected organization, brand, and board (so the save dialog defaults are remembered).

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul99/li3/p.text: An offline retry queue containing pending saves that the Extension was unable to deliver due to a temporary network issue (cleared once delivered).

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p100.text: This data is stored locally and is not synchronized to other devices via Chrome Sync. You can clear all of it at any time by clicking "Disconnect" in the Extension popup, which signs you out and erases all locally stored Extension data.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p103.text: If you choose email and password, your credentials are sent over HTTPS to Parker's backend, which validates them against Parker's user database (hosted by our identity provider, Supabase) and immediately discards them. Passwords are never stored, logged, or transmitted by the Extension itself, and Parker's authentication route does not retain or log them beyond the single credential check Supabase performs on the request.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p105.text: In both cases, on success the Extension receives the same access and refresh tokens it would receive from a sign-in on the web; the Extension stores them locally as described in §16.5.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p107.text: In addition to the rights described in §7 of this Policy, when using the Extension you may:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul108/li0/.text: Sign out and erase local data

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p110.text: When the Extension makes a request to a supported platform on your behalf (for example, the Facebook GraphQL fetch described in §16.2), that request is governed by the receiving platform's own terms of service and privacy policy. Real Simple Labs is not responsible for how third-party platforms log, retain, or use the requests your browser makes during normal use of their services.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/h3111/stro.text: 16.9 Third-Party Services Used by the Extension

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p112.text: The data the Extension sends to Parker (described in §16.3) is transmitted to and processed by the following third-party services. Each is also disclosed in §5 (Third-Party Services) for the broader Parker platform; this list calls out the services specifically involved in the Extension's data flow:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p116.text: The Extension is subject to the same age restrictions described in §12. The Extension is not intended for, and should not be used by, individuals under the age of 18, or under the age required by the underlying platform's own terms (which may be higher in some jurisdictions).

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p118.text: This section describes how the "Save from Instagram" feature collects, uses, and protects your information. The feature lets you save Instagram content to your Parker swipe file by sending it as a Direct Message to a Parker-operated Instagram account — no browser extension required. It relies on the Instagram Platform (specifically the Instagram messaging API) and, in addition to this Policy, is subject to the Meta Platform Terms and the Instagram Platform Policy. This feature is separate from the Save to Parker Browser Extension described in §16; the Extension does not read Instagram Direct messages, and this feature does not involve the Extension.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul120/li2/.text: Once linked, when you send (DM) an Instagram reel, post, image, or video to the Parker Instagram Account, Parker receives that message through Instagram's messaging API, saves the shared content to your Parker swipe file, and sends you a short confirmation reply in the same conversation. If we receive a message from an Instagram account that is not linked, we reply with linking instructions and do not save the content.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/h3121/stro.text: 17.2 Information We Receive Through This Feature

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p122.text: When you link your account and send messages to the Parker Instagram Account, we receive from the Instagram Platform:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul123/li2/.text: Publicly displayed metadata for shared reels:

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul126/li0/.text: To save the content you send into the correct Parker swipe file (the organization, brand, and board associated with your link) and to display it with its metadata and media.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul126/li1/.text: To send you a confirmation reply — or, if your Instagram account is not yet linked, linking instructions.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul126/li2/.text: To operate, secure, and troubleshoot the feature.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul129/li0/.text: The link between your Instagram account and your Parker account, the saved ideas, and the associated media are stored on Parker's infrastructure (Supabase database and file storage; see §4 and §5), with the same security controls described in §4.3.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul129/li1/.text: Saved ideas and their media are retained under the retention rules in §4.2 for as long as they remain in your swipe file.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul129/li2/.text: The one-time linking codes are short-lived, single-use, and stored only in hashed form.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/ul131/li3/.text: You may also stop using the feature at any time simply by not sending messages to the Parker Instagram Account.

div1/div2/div1/div0/div1/div0/p133.text: The Instagram Platform delivers your messages to Parker and provides the identifiers and metadata described above; your use of Instagram remains governed by Instagram's and Meta's own terms and privacy policies. Media and metadata retrieval and storage use the same third-party services described in §5 and §16.9 (Supabase for database and file storage; Vercel for hosting). Real Simple Labs is not responsible for how Instagram or Meta logs, retains, or uses the messages you send through their platform.
